履修条件
履修証明プログラム「建築デジタル人材育成プログラム」履修生であること。
Participants should be enrolled in the certificate program “Program for Developing Digital Professionals in Architecture”
授業概要
当該履修証明プログラムにて整備された学習環境下にて、受講生自身の方法によってデジタルにおけるモノづくりの理解を深めます。担 当教員は適宜、意見交換や助言を行いますが、受講生が主体的に進めていきます。最終成果物の提出と発表の機械を設けますが、成果物の形式は問いません。
In the learning environment developed through the certificate program, students will deepen their understanding of digital fabrication through their own methods. While the mentor will provide feedback and guidance as needed, the students are expected to take the lead in proceeding their projects forward. A final submission and presentation of the outcome will be required; however, the format of the final deliverable is open-ended.
